     1	import dlt
     2	from pyspark.sql.functions import col, current_timestamp
     3	from pyspark.sql.types import *
     4	from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
     5	
     6	spark = SparkSession.getActiveSession()
     7	catalog = spark.conf.get("catalog")
     8	pipeline_schema = spark.conf.get("pipeline_schema")
     9	volume = spark.conf.get("volume")
    10	file_path = f"/Volumes/{catalog}/{pipeline_schema}/{volume}/distributor/"
    11	
    12	# Explicit schema from metadata_distributor.json
    13	schema = StructType([
    14	    StructField("distributor_id", IntegerType(), nullable=False),
    15	    StructField("distributor_name", StringType(), nullable=True),
    16	    StructField("phone_number", StringType(), nullable=True),
    17	    StructField("street_address", StringType(), nullable=True),
    18	    StructField("postal_code", StringType(), nullable=True),
    19	    StructField("city", StringType(), nullable=True),
    20	    StructField("state", StringType(), nullable=True),
    21	    StructField("country", StringType(), nullable=True),
    22	    StructField("operation", StringType(), nullable=False)
    23	])
    24	
    25	@dlt.view(name="raw_distributor")
    26	def raw_distributor():
    27	    df = spark.readStream.format("cloudFiles") \
    28	        .option("cloudFiles.format", "json") \
    29	        .option("multiline", "true") \
    30	        .schema(schema) \
    31	        .load(file_path)
    32	    return df.withColumn("ingestion_time", current_timestamp())
    33	
    34	dlt.create_streaming_table("distributor_cdc_stream")
    35	
    36	dlt.apply_changes(
    37	    target="distributor_cdc_stream",
    38	    source=dlt.read("raw_distributor"),
    39	    keys=["distributor_id"],
    40	    sequence_by=col("ingestion_time"),
    41	    apply_as_deletes=col("operation") == "delete",
    42	    except_column_list=["operation", "ingestion_time"],
    43	    stored_as_scd_type=2
    44	)
